sources.name: Anyscale press release, Founders of Open Source Project Ray Launch Anyscale

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. According to its site, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud. The site describes orchestration of model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability, and it promotes an upcoming webinar on production-ready distributed inference with Ray Serve.

The company's own materials trace its origin to the founders of the open source project Ray, who launched Anyscale with USD 20.6m in funding, described in the press release as intended to democratize distributed programming. The site quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale gives his team the flexibility to scale workloads seamlessly, removing infrastructure risk, and an unnamed applied AI engineer describing a model going from selection to production in a day where it previously would have taken a week or more.

The record also lists California as a jurisdiction of law exposure, with a count of 282. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded.
